title: Hormonal Optimization: Late vs. Immediate Start After Discontinuation of Oral Contraceptives in Assisted Reproductive technologY (HOLIDAY)
official: A Randomized Blinded Controlled Trial Assessing Hormonal Optimization: Late vs. Immediate Start After Discontinuation of Oral Contraceptives in Assisted Reproductive technologY (HOLIDAY)
summary: HOLIDAY is a two-arm, parallel-group, multi-center, randomized trial in which subjects undergoing planned oocyte cryopreservation will be randomized to receive either a 2-month pause of Combined Hormonal Contraceptives (CHC) or immediate start (without a pause).
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

1. Ovary-bearing individuals 18 to 40 years of age.
2. BMI \< 40 kg/m2
3. Non-smoker for at least 3 months prior to study enrollment.

Exclusion Criteria:

1. BMI greater than or equal to 40 kg/m2
2. Current Smoker
3. Any contraindications to ovarian stimulation or outpatient egg retrieval under anesthesia
